messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Vela Therapeutics POC ready. Procurement will only accept invoice to their EU entity but cites the MSA signed with our US entity. They asked for an SLA line and DPA with EU controller language. Can we ship POC without redoing the MSA? @emma_legal @raj_finance

emma_legal: Short: yes, via a 1-page billing linkage addendum. We'll attach OF + addendum + DPA in one envelope. Need KYC for Vela EU and confirm which Redwood entity will actually bill. Also propose limiting SLA for POC (availability target + credit cap).

sara_sales: They provided VAT IT123456789, PO# VELA-22, prefer EUR, net30. Timeline: want signed before Monday.

raj_finance: Finance note: EU billing requires IBAN/SWIFT and VAT on invoice. If billing entity = Redwood EU, invoices must go to our EU bank. We can accept cross-entity addendum but need internal AR memo for intercompany. Net30 okay. Also confirm POC amount so we can make provisional invoice.

devin_solutions: Delivery: POC is non-production, limited dataset. If DPA required with EU controller language, we can scope processing to EU region. Ops confirmable but need time.

emma_legal: I'll draft addendum: (a) designate Redwood Inference EU LLC as billing party for OF, (b) link OF to the existing US MSA with a statement that MSA terms apply unless expressly modified, (c) SLA limited to POC with credit cap at 15% of fee, (d) electronic signatures binding. Will post redline in #legal-drafts in 25m.

sara_sales: Filing KYC and pushing PO now. If we get addendum signed by Friday COB, can we get invoice processed?

raj_finance: Yes — treasury needs executed docs by Fri 16:00 CET for month-end processing. Invoice-bot: please create provisional invoice VELA-22 for EUR 6,500 (POC).

esign-bot: esign-bot: Recommend single envelope: OF + billing linkage addendum + DPA v2. Audit trail enabled. Template: /ops/templates/linkage-eu-billing-v2.docx

emma_legal: Great. I'll include explicit entity name fields on signature page to avoid ambiguity. Pinging ops to confirm DocuSign template usage.

sara_sales: Thanks team — routing now. Will update when Vela signs. :thumbsup:
